{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.72

|gr1= Custom Panels

|descr= Returns information about what is currently displayed on given player's info panel.

|s1= [[infoPanel]] infoPanelId

|p1= infoPanelId: [[String]] - info panel classname, or "left" or "right"

|r1= [[Array]] with [componentClass, componentType]
* componentClass: [[String]] - ''EmptyDisplay'' when no panel is open
* componentType: [[String]] -  ''EmptyDisplayComponent'' when no panel is open

|x1= <sqf>infoPanel "left" params ["_componentClass", "_componentType"];</sqf>

|seealso= [[Arma 3: Custom Info]] [[infoPanels]] [[setInfoPanel]] [[infoPanelComponents]] [[enableInfoPanelComponent]] [[infoPanelComponentEnabled]] [[openGPS]]
}}
